scope: Web classic templates, BBQ assembly and seeded meal finishing; substantive cooking review, not a repeat of the structural matrix.

findings.before: 12 open jumbo shells,650g raw sausage+120g onion (~64g filling/shell), an additional4buns,2-minute initial boil and a dry45–70-minute smoke; cannelloni and open-shell shapes were interchangeable aliases.
findings.after: 20 open jumbo shells,500g sausage or500g drained beans+120g onion (~31g filling/shell), slaw without buns. Packet al-dente boil, opening-up in a covered dish with100mlwater/4servings, brief final smoke only once cooked. Raw sausage retains75C endpoint. Cannelloni identity alias removed.

findings.before: Miso/fresh regional finish was completed before its sauce cooked with cubed brisket for45–90minutes; small recipe advertised160minutes while its required serial braise/rest/pan stages could exceed4hours.
findings.after: Only cooked regional sauce base enters the pan cook; one explicit fresh finish follows tender cubes and the cooked sauce base, off heat. Small cook estimate290min and full350min cover stated stages. Plant cubes also finish after their heat stage.

findings.before: 45min cooking despite6min vegetables+6–8min mince+10–12min simmer+20–25min bake+5min rest.
findings.after: 60min meat/55min lentil cooking estimate; potatoes and regional sauce still overlap other cooking.

findings.before: 110min cooking excluded the explicitly required15min rest. Similar omissions occurred in brisket/pulled shoulder/mince loaf.
findings.after: BBQ estimate is at least the sum of its authored serial main heat/rest stages, excluding the first prep stage and without double-counting overlapping sides/sauce. Whole chicken125min; brisket385min; pulled shoulder440min; mince loaf100min.

findings.before: Seed finishing vegetables were prepared only after the main endpoint, adding8minutes before sauce finishing and plating.
findings.after: Fast-main mise en place precedes its final cooking step; warm additions are timed during its final minutes. Slow-main preparation overlaps its final8cooking/rest minutes. Fresh garnish and delicate sauce finish remain after cooking; no8-minute wait imposed on a fresh crust.

sources.supports: Open jumbo shell identity, packet-directed partial cooking and moist covered baking to keep shells soft. Our dairy-free smoker recipe is an authored adaptation, not this manufacturer recipe.
Producer recipe uses modest spoonfuls of filling in open jumbo shells, rather than our previous oversized mound. Our measured filling per shell is calculated from our own recipe quantities.
For soup/sauce aroma, dissolve miso and add near the end off heat. This does not claim miso can never be cooked as a glaze or marinade.

limits: This is a source-backed recipe-content review, not tasting, physical kitchen validation or allergy/cross-contact certification.
No full2million-case matrix, website deployment, Android build or APK installation performed in this subtask.
Whole meats, main cuts,90meal-builder sides and Android generators are audited by other owners.
Existing dirty-tree work was preserved; only the listed owned source/tests and bounded evidence outputs changed here.
